title: Access control models (RBAC, DAC, MAC)
goal_html: Students practice identifying which access control model (DAC, MAC, or RBAC) is in play in a scenario, and evaluate whether a specific access request should be allowed. Ties to LO 5.2.A.
steps_html:
1. Each group opens the simulation and works through the access-request queue, agreeing on ALLOW or DENY for each request under the model/policy shown before submitting.
  2. For each request, the group also names which model (DAC, MAC, or RBAC) is being enforced and points to the specific rule that produced the decision (owner grant, label comparison, or role permission).
  3. Groups design one original scenario (a subject, object, and model) and trade with another group to decide ALLOW/DENY.
collaborate_html: Assign roles: a "policy owner" states the rule in plain language, an "auditor" verifies the decision against the rule, and a "recorder" writes the justification. Rotate roles each request.
exit_html: Each student submits: one request they evaluated + the model in play + the ALLOW/DENY decision and why.
